title: Deliver the round-1 brief via herdr agent prompt, not agent start argv
action: Per D1: execute_new stops appending the brief to agent start argv; it starts the agent with the agent_command tokens only, then on start success sends the rendered brief with herdr agent prompt (same call shape execute_continue uses), then enters the existing poll loop. A prompt-send failure is a typed spawn-phase failure (pane kept per the existing failure rule). Update the seam tests: start_calls carry no brief text; prompt_calls receive the round-1 brief; the live-smoke failure shape (agent start refusing an unencodable argv) can no longer occur by construction.

truths: agent start argv contains only agent_command tokens, never the brief
the round-1 brief arrives via agent prompt before polling begins
